sources.title: ECB, EU Balance of Payments and International Investment Position statistical sources and methods, July 2025
sources.read: Sections 3.1 on employee compensation and 3.2 on investment income, including retained direct-investment earnings.
sources.supports: Nonresident employee pay is primary income; without an employment relationship payment is for services. Direct-investment retained earnings are recorded when earned.
sources.limits: Definitions and classification choices; the scenarios assume employee relationships and direct-investment equity and do not select future legal institutions.
